irene: Heads-up: sales wants a CSV import tool so SAs can onboard role bindings in bulk (mapping csv columns -> principal, role, routes, ttl). Wants validation & preview before apply.

pete: Ok but big caveat: bulky imports risk thrashing routing cache if we create many bindings at once. need pacing or batching.

yun: API idea: POST /admin/bulk-bindings/validate (accepts CSV or JSON array) -> returns preview_id + per-row result {ok|error, reason, estimated_quota}. Then POST /admin/bulk-bindings/apply with preview_id to commit.

claire: UX: show a small sample of parsed rows in preview, highlight rows with errors, allow inline edit of individual rows before commit. keep max rows per upload (e.g., 500).

ops-bot: Warning: large apply triggers routing cache invalidation. We'll add an apply_rate_limit default (50 binds/min) and a fast-path for small imports.

pete: Implementation: apply should accept throttle parameters and return an async job id. job progress events emitted to console. include metrics: binds.applied, binds.failed, invalidation.latency.

sec-bot: Security: audit every commit with actor, preview_id, csv_hash, and require org_admin 2FA for >50 bindings. disallow wildcard routes in CSV unless org exception.

yun: For preview we should compute diffs vs existing effective permissions and show +/- counts. include a small telemetry event: bulk_bind_preview with counts and preview_latency_ms.

claire: UX nit: include a toggle "auto-split into batches" and show expected completion time. Also a link to revert within 24h per binding.

irene: rollout: internal -> pilot with 3 customers -> org-flag. default max rows 100 for pilot.

ops-bot: Note: we'll implement server-side pacing and track throttled jobs. Add alert if job failure rate > 5% during pilot.

pete: I'll write RFC for endpoints + job queue change. yun will add preview endpoint. claire will prototype CSV parsing UI + inline editor. sec-bot to confirm 2FA threshold.

irene: thanks all — file RFC refs here once created. :thumbsup:
